name: Barockschloss Mannheim: Prickelnder Genuss im Glanz der Kronleuchter
description: evening palace tour by chandelier light with a glass of sparkling wine
dateNote: only Sat 21 Nov and Sat 28 Nov, 17:00
details:
A special evening tour ("Genuss & Geschichte") through the lit Beletage of the Baroque palace of Mannheim. It is about the chandeliers and the court festivities of the electoral residence, with little-known details and anecdotes; one glass of sparkling wine is included.

Two dates: Saturday 21 and Saturday 28 November, 17:00, about 1.5 to 2 hours. 18 EUR (reduced 9 EUR). Meeting point: visitor centre in the central wing, museum entrance. Registration is required at the Service-Center (+49 6221 658880, service@schloss-mannheim.com); at most 30 people.
